name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: ⬆️ Move up to a hive: on a nuc's page, move it into a 10- or 8-frame hive. It stays the same hive (same queen, same records); the empty nuc goes back to storage.

🟨 Pro Nuc: pick 5-frame, then Box › Pro Nuc (plastic). It's drawn the way it looks, with its sliding gate in the front end (Open, Cracked or Closed) and its two lid ports: a soda bottle in one, a gallon jug in the other.

🍯 More than one feeder on a hive, one of each kind: say a pollen patty on top while an entrance feeder gives syrup. "+ Add another feeder" in the hive's setup; the Feeding form asks which one you filled.
🔎 Check the feeders: on the hive page (🍯 Check feeders), in an inspection or by voice, say how full each is. Jars are just counted ("1 empty, 2 half, 1 quarter"), never numbered.
⏰ Feeding reminders: right away when anything's empty or at ¼, and on the day it'll get low at the rate that hive's been taking it. Two or more in a yard make one reminder; tap it to see which hives.

🫙 Jars or a bucket on top, outside: 1 to 4 quart jars, a 1-, 2- or 4-gallon pail, or a 5-gallon bucket, upside down over the inner cover. They're drawn on the hive, with no telescoping cover while they're on.
